note: Manually verified offers. This file is the ONLY place a human adds inventory by hand. Records here go through exactly the same quality gate as any feed — see api/_offers.js gate(). Nothing is published because it was typed here; it is published because it passes.
howToAdd: 1. Confirm the code at the merchant yourself. Do not copy it from another coupon site.
2. Add a record below with storeId matching data/stores.json, and verifiedAt set to the ISO timestamp of YOUR check.
3. Set expires to the date the merchant states. Leave it null if the merchant does not publish one — do not guess.
4. Put every published restriction in terms[]. These drive the store page's troubleshooting section, so paraphrasing changes what shoppers are told.
5. Run `npm run inventory` — a REJECTED status means the record is wrong, not that the gate is wrong.
6. Re-verify before the 48h window lapses, or the offer degrades to UNKNOWN and stops being presented as verified.

fields.title: required — what the shopper gets, in plain words
fields.code: required when type=code, must be absent when type=deal
fields.value: numeric discount; 30 for 30% off, 8 for $8 off
fields.expires: YYYY-MM-DD as published by the merchant, or null
fields.terms: array of the merchant's published conditions, verbatim
fields.verifiedAt: ISO timestamp of the human check
